intent.notes: Redpoint attempts and route projecting on gym routes at or near target grade. Primary session for performance phase lead climbers. Quality over quantity — 2-4 burns max, full rest between attempts. Opens with 2-3 maintenance falls right after the warm-up (the try-hard component of the performance phase).

modules.notes: 2-3 maintenance falls at the start of the day, before the first burn: the redpoint attempts are where you commit, so the fall is rehearsed while fresh. Strict pin: without rope routes the block fails instead of degrading.

prescription_overrides.notes: 2-3 falls on the first easy lap, from a normal lead position above the clip, with your usual belayer. Push away from the wall, feet facing it, knees soft. Then go to the project and commit: fall rather than take.

modules.notes: Primary module. Redpoint attempts on project-level routes. Full rest between burns.
